description: This file defines a utility enum 'SimpleTaskSupport' that provides static methods for managing asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and running a detached loop with periodic execution.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a task if not already running, executing the given asynchronous operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels and clears the current task.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached task that repeatedly executes an asynchronous operation at specified intervals until cancelled.
